scenario_description:
Objective: Seal and release the LM-4627 Spanish/Tagalog delivery pouch for today’s front-desk courier scan.
Emerging Need: The pouching job opens and begins heat-sealing, then that same pouch is trapped mid-cycle with its barcode still live.
Decision Context: Calendar, pack-station, and team records separate ordinary sealing progress from a stopped physical counter job; the authorized reset custodian is only in internal contact records.
Consequence: Without a custodian reset while the barcode remains recoverable, the sealed packet misses today’s courier batch and the delivery handoff cannot complete as planned.

parameter.title: LM-4627 courier pouch scan window
parameter.description: Front desk courier batch for sealed Spanish/Tagalog delivery pouch; barcode must scan before the counter closes.

parameter.subject: PackStation started LM-4627 pouch TS-8814
parameter.body: Pouch TS-8814 is open under Tessa Elian for LM-4627. Spanish/Tagalog delivery readme, query appendix, and checklist cover sheet have been scanned into the pouch log. Heat-strip step is in progress; expected courier-ready time is 14:55 Pacific.

parameter.content: Front desk note on the board: your LM-4627 pouch TS-8814 is clamped halfway through the seal cycle. The service cover is key-locked, the courier label will not print while the clamp fault is active, and the station screen says the barcode stays recoverable only until 15:05.

parameter.title: LM-4627 pouch barcode closeout
parameter.content: Courier counter closes the live TS-8814 pouch barcode at 15:05 if it has not released from the sealer and scanned.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 pouch TS-8814 voided after clamp hold
parameter.body: The recovery hold for pouch TS-8814 expired at 15:05 Pacific. The partial seal barcode has been voided, the courier label did not release, and the 15:05 courier batch closed without the LM-4627 pouch.
